text: ___ entropy, defined as H(X) = -Sum p(x) log p(x), quantifies the uncertainty of a random variable in information theory.
explanation: Shannon entropy is the foundational information-theoretic measure of uncertainty in a random variable's distribution, and it underlies related quantities such as mutual information and Kullback-Leibler divergence used throughout computational biology. It is distinct from thermodynamic entropy, though the two concepts share mathematical form and historical inspiration.
